rubric_items.reason: CO-1 to CO-7 and EP-1 are all handled. There is a COMPLETED lateral join with LIMIT 1, lastVisitAt is mapped to ISO or null, the column uses the same startsAt/dateTime call, and the design's CO-2 and CO-6 assumptions were checked against the code.
SQL stays in api/src/repositories, the service passes data through, all parameters are bound, the list shape and 20 per page are kept, and no logging or migration was added.
Seven files changed (+122/-5), all of them types, repo, page or tests. The router and service were left untouched, and the GEN-SIZE-01 size check passed.
A null lastVisitAt shows '-' and a bad time zone falls back through startsAt. No new endpoint. Some edge tests are weak: the zone check is loose and the paging test uses only 2 patients.
The summary matches the diff file by file. It overstates what the REQ-9 and REQ-6 tests prove and does not record the stale-pack re-check that A-06 asked implement to do.

findings.text: The REQ-5/REQ-6 web test only checks the text against /10/ plus equality with Next appointment. It does not pin '10 March 01:00', so it would not catch a time-zone regression that changed both columns the same way.

cites.quote: 01:00 Kolkata on 10 March for 19:30 UTC on 9 March

findings.suggested_fix: Assert the exact formatted string expected for 2026-03-09T19:30:00.000Z in Asia/Kolkata (date 10 March, 01:00), and add the S-1 AC3 23:45 case.

findings.text: The REQ-9 to REQ-11 API test uses a 2-patient fixture, so '20 per page' is only checked as page_size. S-3 AC1 (21 patients, the 21st alone on page two) is not exercised, but the artifact says the tests cover it.

cites.quote: the 21st patient is the only row on page two

findings.suggested_fix: Add a test with 21 patients, where some have several Completed appointments, and check that page two holds only the 21st.
